# Periodic strip reference v1

This 10 mm square planar linear-air model has a 12 A, one-turn series circuit,
zero-A top and bottom boundaries, and matching periodic left and right
boundaries. The frozen answer was generated by unmodified stock FEMM 4.2;
`freeze_reference.lua` documents the procedure and circuit-property export.

The generic artifact preserves all stock `.pbc` pairs. The regression compares
nodal potential by coordinate, checks every paired result, and compares circuit
flux linkage. Both quantities match stock FEMM within the 1e-10 relative test
limit.

The stock FEMM installation is a read-only input. It is not copied into this
fixture and is never modified by the test.
